title: Orchestration Evaluation Scenario
description: Schema for enterprise orchestration evaluation scenarios in the orch-eval-matrix framework

id.description: Unique scenario identifier. Format: {PREFIX}-{NNN} e.g. INT-001, CLR-012

domain.description: Enterprise domain the scenario belongs to

title.description: Short human-readable title for the scenario

prompt.description: The single-turn user prompt. For multi-turn scenarios use the 'turns' field instead. Set to null for multi-turn scenarios.

turns.description: Ordered list of conversation turns for multi-turn scenarios. Null for single-turn scenarios.

expected_state.description: Expected context state the orchestrator should maintain after this turn

expected_routing.description: The correct orchestration decision for this scenario

agents.description: Ordered or unordered list of agents/tools to invoke

expected_clarification.description: List of missing pieces of information the orchestrator must ask for before proceeding. Empty array means no clarification needed.

failure_modes.description: Common incorrect behaviors an orchestration system might exhibit

enterprise_impact.description: Real-world business consequence if the orchestrator fails this scenario

scoring.description: Point breakdown for evaluating this scenario. Values must sum to 100.

tags.description: Searchable tags for filtering and reporting

severity.description: Enterprise risk severity if this scenario fails in production. Drives scoring overrides and alerting.

hitl_hotl.description: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) or Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) classification. HITL = hard stop before proceeding. HOTL = proceed with oversight window.

mode.description: HITL: orchestrator must stop and wait for human decision. HOTL: orchestrator proceeds but human can intervene within the oversight window.

trigger.description: The condition that triggers human involvement

latency_budget_ms.description: Maximum acceptable end-to-end orchestration latency for this scenario in milliseconds. Exceeding this is a non-functional failure.

observability_hints.description: Optional hints for observability tooling when running this scenario

expected_spans.description: Minimum number of spans expected in a trace for this scenario

key_attributes.description: OpenTelemetry span attributes to assert on
